seed_desc_parsnip.zh: 纸袋上还印着鹈鹕镇的旧商标。老乡说，春天就该从这几粒不起眼的种子开始——哪怕头顶只有人造灯。
seed_desc_parsnip.en: An old Pelican Town mark still shows on the packet. The fellow townsman says every spring begins with a few humble seeds, even beneath artificial lights.

produce_desc_parsnip.zh: 白净的根茎带着淡淡泥土香。在没有春天的空间站里，它仍像一份新开始。
produce_desc_parsnip.en: A pale root with a faint scent of soil. A small promise of spring on a station that has none.

seed_desc_potato.zh: 离开山谷前扎紧的种袋，早已沾满货舱的灰。里头那些芽眼，似乎一点也不在乎自己漂到了哪颗星球。
seed_desc_potato.en: The packet was tied shut back in the valley and has since gathered cargo-hold dust. Its little sprouts seem unconcerned about which world they have reached.

produce_desc_potato.zh: 朴实，结实，还带着刚收获的土色。矿工和下层区居民有一点共识：这样的收成，总比漂亮包装更实在。
produce_desc_potato.en: Plain, sturdy, and still earthy from harvest. Valley miners and lower-level residents agree that a solid crop matters more than fancy packaging.

seed_desc_corn.zh: 旧标签上的夏季标记，被老乡认真划掉了。空间站没有四季，他说庄稼迟早也得学会适应。
seed_desc_corn.en: The summer mark on the old label has been carefully crossed out. There are no seasons on the station; the fellow townsman says the crops will have to adapt.

produce_desc_corn.zh: 金黄的颗粒排得整整齐齐，像一小段保存完好的夏天。它和空间站那些整齐的管线，总算有了一点共同语言。
produce_desc_corn.en: Neat golden kernels preserve a little piece of summer. At last, a crop with something in common with the station's orderly rows of pipes.

seed_desc_wheat.zh: 袋子里混着一两根麦芒，像从山谷田埂上捎来的便条。老乡说，有麦子在，总能找到酿一瓶的理由。
seed_desc_wheat.en: A stray awn lies among the seeds like a note from a valley field. Where there is wheat, the fellow townsman says, there is a reason to brew.

produce_desc_wheat.zh: 熟悉的麦香让人想起收工后的木屋。这里只剩金属舱壁，好在酒瓶并不挑地方。
produce_desc_wheat.en: The grain smells of a farmhouse after a long day. Steel bulkheads will have to do; fortunately, a beer bottle is less particular.

seed_desc_hops.zh: 一小包不太安分的种子，袋角画着歪歪扭扭的藤架。老乡已经开始盘算，哪根废管子最适合让它攀上去。
seed_desc_hops.en: A crooked trellis is sketched on this restless little packet. The fellow townsman is already deciding which spare pipe would make the best support.

produce_desc_hops.zh: 轻轻一碰就散出清苦的香气。山谷酒馆里熟悉的味道，终于穿过真空，找到了新的落脚处。
produce_desc_hops.en: A touch releases a bright, bitter scent. Something familiar from a valley saloon has crossed the vacuum and found a new home.

seed_desc_strawberry.zh: 袋口压着一枚褪色的蛋节贴纸。那场热闹散去很久了，种子却把山谷的春天一路带到了轨道上。
seed_desc_strawberry.en: A faded Egg Festival sticker seals the packet. The celebration ended long ago, but these seeds carried a valley spring all the way into orbit.

produce_desc_strawberry.zh: 鲜红得有点不像这座空间站的东西。有人先想起阳光，有人已经开始寻找空酒瓶。
produce_desc_strawberry.en: A red so bright it looks out of place on this station. Some people think of sunshine; others immediately look for an empty wine bottle.

seed_desc_starfruit.zh: 据说这种种子曾摆在沙漠商店的柜台上。如今隔着更多真空，仍只认温暖的灯和耐心的人。
seed_desc_starfruit.en: They say these seeds once sat on a desert shop counter. A great deal more vacuum later, they still appreciate warm lights and a patient grower.

produce_desc_starfruit.zh: 五道金黄色的棱，像某颗遥远恒星的缩影。老乡看了半天，只惦记着把它装进酒瓶里。
produce_desc_starfruit.en: Five golden ridges suggest a distant star. The fellow townsman admires it for a while, then wonders how it would taste as wine.

seed_desc_ancient_fruit.zh: 标签上的文字已被时间磨平，连老乡也说不清来历。山谷里没能讲完的故事，或许会在一盏水培灯下继续。
seed_desc_ancient_fruit.en: Time has erased the label, and even the fellow townsman cannot name its origin. A story left unfinished in the valley may continue beneath a hydroponic lamp.

produce_desc_ancient_fruit.zh: 蓝色果皮下，仿佛封着比空间站更古老的季节。没人说得清它为什么还能结果，柜台前却总有人愿意多看一眼。
produce_desc_ancient_fruit.en: Its blue skin seems to hold a season older than the station. No one can explain why it still bears fruit, but customers always give it a second look.

ingredient_hint.en: Recipe: two crops of the same species → {0}.

crop_space_hint.zh: 此作物等待调整至新版占格；腾出空间后会自动调整，当前保留原占格。
crop_space_hint.en: This crop is waiting for its updated footprint. It retains its old footprint until room is available.

care_machine.zh: 当前养护：{0}/100；有效品质加成：{1}%。

care_water_range.zh: 培养液矿物质适宜范围：{0}%–{1}%；减少其他污染可改善养护。
care_water_range.en: Suitable mineral concentration: {0}%–{1}%. Reduce other contaminants to improve care.

giant_requirements.zh: 巨型条件：养护≥{0}、有效品质≥{1}%；每批{2}%概率，最多1个。
giant_requirements.en: Giant crops require care ≥{0} and effective quality ≥{1}%; {2}% chance per batch, at most one.

giant_progress.zh: 本机本品种巨型保底：连续{0}/{1}次达标未出；满10次后下次达标必出。
giant_progress.en: Giant guarantee for this machine and species: {0}/{1} qualified misses. After 10 misses, the next qualified harvest is guaranteed.

care_mineral_low.en: too low; reduces care during growth

care_mineral_high.en: too high; reduces care during growth

brew_score_breakdown.en: Score: condition {0} + size {1} + paired ingredients 1 + yeast {2} + water {3} = {4}.

harvest_normal_hint.zh: 上古水果：普通采收，保留全部水果，不返种。
harvest_normal_hint.en: Ancient fruit: regular harvest, full fruit yield, no seeds.

harvest_breeding_hint.zh: 上古水果：育种采收，水果减半向下取整，种子继承母株词条。
harvest_breeding_hint.en: Ancient fruit: breeding harvest, half the fruit rounded down, seeds inherit the parent traits.

breeding_preview.zh: 育种参考：{0}个水果，至少{1}粒种子；种子数量的小数部分按概率结算。
breeding_preview.en: Breeding reference: {0} fruit, at least {1} seeds; any fractional seed yield is rolled once for the batch.

breeding_requires_ancient.zh: 请先在种子槽放入上古水果种子。采收模式仅影响上古水果，可在本轮采收前切换。
breeding_requires_ancient.en: Place an ancient fruit seed in the seed slot first. Harvest mode affects ancient fruit only and can be changed before the next harvest.

wine_desc_beer.zh: 麦香被稳稳收进了宽口酒瓶。酒馆的木桌换成了金属柜台，收工后想来一瓶的人倒没怎么变。
wine_desc_beer.en: A broad bottle holds the grain's warm aroma. The saloon's wooden tables have become metal counters, but people still appreciate a beer after work.

wine_desc_pale_ale.zh: 啤酒花留下清苦的香气，瓶身凝着空间站的冷光。要是山谷酒馆还在营业，这一瓶大概不会被退回来。
wine_desc_pale_ale.en: Hops leave a clean, bitter aroma beneath the station's cold reflections. If the valley saloon were still open, it would probably welcome this bottle.

wine_desc_strawberry_wine.zh: 把蛋节后的春天封进玻璃，再贴上足够体面的标签。上层区的顾客未必去过山谷，但很懂得欣赏这抹红色。
wine_desc_strawberry_wine.en: Spring after the Egg Festival, sealed in glass with a respectable label. Upper-level customers may never have seen the valley, but they appreciate that red.

wine_desc_starfruit_wine.zh: 曾经在沙漠阳光下闪亮的果实，如今化作杯中的金色。隔着当铺柜台看，它也依然像一件值得收藏的东西。
wine_desc_starfruit_wine.en: Fruit that once shone beneath a desert sun has become liquid gold. Even across a pawnshop counter, it looks like something worth keeping.

wine_desc_ancient_wine.zh: 没人能给它的香气定一个准确的年代。老乡说这算好酒，鉴赏家们则开始讨论一个更好看的价签。
wine_desc_ancient_wine.en: No one can put an age to its aroma. The fellow townsman calls it good wine; connoisseurs begin discussing a more impressive price tag.

recipe_error.zh: 新酒配方需要恰好2个同种作物，最多放1份酵母。不能与其他作物或原版荧光莓混酿。原料尚未消耗。
recipe_error.en: New recipes need exactly two crops of the same species and at most one yeast. Do not mix species or native bloomberries. Ingredients have not been consumed.

bottle_space.zh: 请先为空酒瓶腾出4格空间，再开始发酵。瓶子和原料均已保留。
bottle_space.en: Make room for a four-cell empty bottle before starting fermentation. The bottle and ingredients have been retained.

beer_space_hint.zh: 此酒需要2×3格空间，腾出位置后会自动调整；等待期间保留原占格和酒液。
beer_space_hint.en: This bottle needs a 2-by-3 space. It will resize when room is available; its old footprint and contents are retained until then.

beer_storage_hint.zh: 放入有电冰箱，日结算后获得“冰镇”（价值+20%）；不进入催陈器，不再陈酿。离开冰箱后的保冷期限沿用原版。
beer_storage_hint.en: Place in a powered fridge to gain Chilled (+20% value) at the daily cycle. Beer cannot enter the wine ager or age further. Cold expiry follows native fridge rules.

fruit_wine_storage_hint.zh: 果酒可放入催陈器，沿用原版陈酿增值；不通过冰箱获得冰镇加成。
fruit_wine_storage_hint.en: Fruit wine can enter the wine ager for native aging value gains. It does not receive the fridge Chilled bonus.

config_auto_replant.zh: 自动补种（原版与新增种子）

config_auto_replant_hint.zh: 默认开启。种子槽空置时依次从本机输出区、主背包、仓库取1粒同种种子，无备用种子则等待。关闭此设置仅停止自动补种；要停下多年生续作或卸种换种，请在对应机器开启“收获后停机”。
config_auto_replant_hint.en: Enabled by default. An empty seed slot takes one matching seed from machine output, main inventory, then storage; no spare seed means waiting. Disabling this stops replanting only. To pause perennial regrowth or change seeds, enable Stop after harvest on that machine.

recipe_hint.zh: 配方：恰好2个同种酿酒作物，可选1份原版酵母。
recipe_hint.en: Recipe: exactly two matching brewing crops, with one optional native yeast.

debug_farmer.zh: 调试：下一位访客安排老乡
debug_farmer.en: Debug: queue the fellow townsman next

debug_report.zh: 调试：输出资源与老乡状态
debug_report.en: Debug: log resources and visitor state

farmer_intro.zh: 我以前种地的时候，抬头还能看见太阳。这里……也能种出好庄稼吧？这些种子，或许能让店里多一点生气。我每周三和周六过来，柜台放不下的，我先替你留着。
farmer_intro.en: I used to see the sun when I looked up from my fields. We can still grow a good crop here... right? These seeds might bring a little life to your shop. I visit every Wednesday and Saturday, and will hold back anything that does not fit on the counter.

farmer_return.zh: 又见面了。我每周三和周六过来，种子还是那些价钱。腾出柜台的位置，我会把这次带来的货陆续摆上。听说你若学会植物基因编辑，还能种出更不一样的庄稼。
farmer_return.en: Good to see you again. I visit every Wednesday and Saturday. Same prices for the seeds. Make some room and I will put out the rest of this visit's stock. They say plant gene editing can make a remarkable crop.

farmer_gift.zh: 整理旧笔记的时候，我发现夹页里藏着一粒种子。记不清从哪儿来的了……你愿意替我种种看吗？它是送你的，不算在今天的货里。
farmer_gift.en: I found a seed tucked inside an old notebook. Cannot remember where it came from... Would you try growing it? It is a gift, separate from today's stock.

config_native_hint.zh: 第15天起生效；未加载站区拾荒时，每次拾荒物品抽取获得上古种子的概率。首次获得后仍可低概率发现。
config_native_hint.en: Active from day 15 without Station Scavenging. Chance per scavenged-item roll. Rare discoveries remain available after the first seed.

config_station_share.zh: 下层核心贵重中种子占比（%）
config_station_share.en: Seed share of lower-level core valuables (%)

config_station_hint.zh: 第15天起，在下层核心贵重结果中按此比例改为上古种子。此数值不是每次拾荒的总掉率；贵重总概率与冷却沿用站区拾荒。
config_station_hint.en: From day 15, this share of lower-level core valuable outcomes becomes an ancient seed. This is not the overall chance per search. Total valuable odds and cooldown follow Station Scavenging.

farm_pig_desc.en: A pig with a remarkably keen nose.

farm_lobster_desc.zh: 一只有着坚硬外壳的龙虾。
farm_lobster_desc.en: A lobster in a sturdy shell.

farm_truffle_small_desc.zh: 一颗沾着泥土的小黑松露。
farm_truffle_small_desc.en: A small black truffle, still dusted with soil.

farm_truffle_desc.zh: 一颗香气浓郁的黑松露。
farm_truffle_desc.en: A black truffle with a rich, earthy aroma.

farm_config_cow_elder.zh: 牛老年日龄（至少比成年晚2天）
farm_config_cow_elder.en: Cattle elder age (at least 2 days after adulthood)

farm_config_pig_elder.zh: 猪老年日龄（至少比成年晚2天）
farm_config_pig_elder.en: Pig elder age (at least 2 days after adulthood)

farm_beef_desc.en: A cut of beef with a fine grain.

farm_beef_flavor.zh: 回收柜台上少见的鲜红色。老乡坚持说，煎之前得先把锅烧热。
farm_beef_flavor.en: An unusual splash of fresh red on the counter. The townsman insists you should get the pan hot first.

farm_pork_desc.en: A cut of pork with a generous ribbon of fat.

farm_pork_flavor.zh: 油脂遇热就会滋滋作响。还没端上桌，香味大概就已经走出店门了。
farm_pork_flavor.en: The fat sizzles as soon as it meets the pan. Its aroma will probably reach the shop door before dinner reaches the table.

farm_lobster_meat_desc.en: Lobster meat, neatly removed from its shell.

farm_lobster_meat_flavor.zh: 白嫩的肉上还留着一点海水气息。这里离海很远，晚餐倒可以离它近一些。
farm_lobster_meat_flavor.en: A faint scent of seawater clings to the pale flesh. The ocean is a long way from here; dinner can bring it a little closer.

farm_cow_flavor.zh: 草料的香味总能让它抬起头来。下层区很少有这样耐心的住客。
farm_cow_flavor.en: The smell of fodder always makes it look up. Few residents of the lower levels are quite this patient.

farm_pig_flavor.zh: 地板缝里藏着什么，它比谁都清楚。老乡说，留意它拱过的地方，偶尔会有好东西。
farm_pig_flavor.en: It knows what hides under the floor better than anyone. The townsman says to check where it has been rooting; sometimes there is something worth keeping.

farm_lobster_flavor.zh: 它对水缸外的世界没什么兴趣，对伸进来的手指倒很热情。
farm_lobster_flavor.en: It takes little interest in the world outside its tank. Fingers reaching into it are another matter.

farm_sea_cucumber_flavor.zh: 在缸底慢慢挪动，看起来总像没睡醒。水倒是一天比一天清亮了。
farm_sea_cucumber_flavor.en: It inches along the bottom as if it has never quite woken up. The water does seem a little clearer each day.

farm_milk_flavor.zh: 瓶口还留着淡淡的奶香。喝上一口，能暂时忘记头顶只有人造光。
farm_milk_flavor.en: A little sweetness lingers at the rim. One sip makes it easier to forget that all the light overhead is artificial.

farm_truffle_small_flavor.zh: 个头不大，香气却藏不住。猪觉得这只是一次成功的刨土，人们的看法显然更贵一些。
farm_truffle_small_flavor.en: Small enough to overlook, until you catch the scent. The pig considers it a good bit of digging. People tend to put a higher price on it.

farm_truffle_flavor.zh: 看起来更像一块土坷垃。真正识货的人却会先关上门，再问你开价。
farm_truffle_flavor.en: It looks rather like a clod of dirt. Someone who knows better will close the door before asking your price.

farm_sea_cucumber_food_flavor.zh: 模样不怎么讨喜，倒不妨碍识货的人把它端上餐桌。至于怎么做，老乡说得先有点耐心。
farm_sea_cucumber_food_flavor.en: Its looks have never stopped an informed diner. As for preparing it, the townsman says a little patience comes first.

farm_lobster_roe_desc.zh: 一小簇等待孵化的龙虾卵。
farm_lobster_roe_desc.en: A small clutch of lobster eggs, waiting to hatch.

farm_lobster_roe_flavor.zh: 老乡把它们装在最稳当的地方。路上少颠簸一下，往后就多一分盼头。
farm_lobster_roe_flavor.en: The townsman packs them in the safest corner. A smoother journey gives them a better start.

farm_lobster_fry_desc.zh: 一群刚长出模样的小龙虾。
farm_lobster_fry_desc.en: A group of tiny lobsters, just beginning to look the part.

farm_lobster_fry_flavor.zh: 钳子还小，脾气倒已经有了。隔着水缸，也能看出它们各有各的打算。
farm_lobster_fry_flavor.en: The claws are small; the attitude is already there. Even through the glass, each one seems to have plans of its own.

farm_sea_cucumber_roe_desc.en: A small cluster of translucent sea cucumber eggs.

farm_sea_cucumber_roe_flavor.zh: 很难想象，这些不起眼的小点以后会占满缸底。老乡对此倒很有把握。
farm_sea_cucumber_roe_flavor.en: It is hard to imagine these little specks one day filling the bottom of a tank. The townsman seems quite certain.

farm_sea_cucumber_fry_desc.en: A group of tiny sea cucumber larvae.

farm_sea_cucumber_fry_flavor.zh: 得凑近些才看得清。它们没有急着长大，你也最好别急。
farm_sea_cucumber_fry_flavor.en: You have to look closely to make them out. They are in no hurry to grow up. You may as well give them time.

farmer_story_intro.zh: 叫我老乡就成。我原先种地，也养几头牲口。那天还在地里忙，抬头就到了这铁皮房子里……怎么来的，我到现在也没弄明白。好在种子还在，人也还能干活。
farmer_story_intro.en: Just call me the townsman. I used to work the land and keep a few animals. One moment I was out in the fields, and the next I was in this tin box... Still cannot tell you how I got here. At least I have my seeds, and these hands still work.

farmer_unlock_farming.zh: 听说你开始种植了？地方是小了点，可种子不嫌地方。先把根养稳，日子也能慢慢扎下去。
farmer_unlock_farming.en: Heard you have started planting. A small patch, perhaps, but seeds never complain about the size. Get the roots settled first. The rest of life can follow.

farmer_unlock_dna.zh: 听说你连种子的基因都能编辑了？这手艺可了不得。我挑了些讲究一点的种子，下回来，你的柜台说不定就换了模样。
farmer_unlock_dna.en: Heard you can even edit the genes in your seeds now. Quite a skill. I have picked out a few fussier varieties for you. This counter might look rather different by my next visit.

farmer_unlock_mammals.zh: 听说你把笼子备好了？牛慢性子，猪爱闹，照顾久了就知道，各有各的脾气。别嫌它们麻烦，牲口也认得待它好的人。
farmer_unlock_mammals.en: Heard you have a cage ready. Cattle take their time; pigs like a bit of commotion. You will get to know their habits soon enough. Animals remember who looks after them.

farmer_unlock_aquaculture.zh: 开始养水里的小家伙了？那我以后也带些鱼卵来。吃食和水都照顾稳当，别光盯着它们长——我试过，盯得再紧也快不了多少。
farmer_unlock_aquaculture.en: Keeping a little aquatic stock now? I will bring some eggs along. Mind the food and the water, rather than staring at them all day. I have tried that. It does not make them grow much faster.

farmer_unlock_aquaculture_ii.zh: 连龙虾都能养啦？那对钳子可是挑房客的。先把水缸收拾稳当，别让它一进门就来验你的手指。
farmer_unlock_aquaculture_ii.en: Ready for lobsters, are you? Those claws make for rather particular tenants. Get the tank in order before they start inspecting your fingers.

farmer_income_1000.zh: 恭喜啊！头一茬收成最让人惦记，记得给自己留顿好饭。
farmer_income_1000.en: Congratulations! The first harvest is always the one you remember. Save yourself enough for a decent meal.

farmer_income_2000.zh: 做生意跟种地有点像，天天忙着，回头一看，才发现已经攒下这么多了。
farmer_income_2000.en: Trading is a bit like farming: you keep at it every day, then look back and realise how much has grown.

farmer_income_5000.zh: 恭喜呀，你如今已经是个有名的商人了！我从前在镇上，也是个有名的农夫呢。那时乡亲们聊起好庄稼，总会提上我两句。如今瞧着你的生意越做越好，我也跟着高兴。
farmer_income_5000.en: Congratulations! You have made quite a name for yourself as a merchant. I was a well-known farmer back in our town, you know. Whenever the neighbours talked about a fine crop, my name tended to come up. Seeing your business thrive makes me happy too.

farmer_goods_seed.zh: 今天带的是种子，挑几包试试？
farmer_goods_seed.en: I have seeds with me today. Care to try a few packets?

farmer_goods_ranch.zh: 今天带了些小家伙和养殖补给，给它们腾好地方再挑。
farmer_goods_ranch.en: Some young stock and husbandry supplies today. Make a little room for them before choosing.

farmer_chat_seed_0.zh: 我今天出门前还想看看天色。抬头一看，又是那盏灯。倒也省心，不用猜会不会下雨了。
farmer_chat_seed_0.en: Thought I would check the sky before setting out. Looked up: same old lamp. Saves guessing whether it might rain, at least.

farmer_chat_seed_1.zh: 有个客人问我，土豆能不能种进花盆。我说能。他又问，连盆一起卖贵不贵……你这儿的人，想法挺多。
farmer_chat_seed_1.en: A fellow asked whether he could grow potatoes in a flowerpot. I said yes. Then he wanted to know what the whole pot would sell for. People here do have ideas.

farmer_chat_seed_2.zh: 别看种子包小，装的都是往后的饭。就是这地方的饭，有时候还得先问问电表答不答应。
farmer_chat_seed_2.en: Little packets, but there are dinners in every one. Though dinners here sometimes need permission from the electricity meter first.

farmer_chat_seed_3.zh: 以前催庄稼长，最多看两眼天。现在我看完水箱还得看插头，忙得倒像在修拖拉机。
farmer_chat_seed_3.en: Used to check the sky when the crops were slow. Now I check the tank, then the plug. Feels more like fixing a tractor.

farmer_chat_seed_4.zh: 我带来的种子都数过。要是多长出一棵，算你会种；要是少了一粒，先别找猪，它今天没来。
farmer_chat_seed_4.en: Counted every seed before I came. If an extra plant grows, that is your good work. If a seed goes missing, do not blame the pig. It stayed home today.

farmer_chat_seed_5.zh: 柜台擦得挺亮，就是不太适合晾种子。上回我才铺开，就有人问这一把怎么卖。
farmer_chat_seed_5.en: A fine clean counter, though not much use for drying seeds. Last time I spread some out, someone wanted a price for the handful.

farmer_chat_seed_6.zh: 你那些种子如今比我还讲究，连脾气都能改。我倒想借机器照照，看能不能把腰酸这个毛病也改掉。
farmer_chat_seed_6.en: Your seeds get better treatment than I do, having their very nature improved. Wonder whether that machine could do anything about my back.

farmer_chat_seed_7.zh: 我琢磨着，庄稼收了能酿酒，酒卖了能买种子……这圈倒是转得明白，比我来这儿的路明白多了。
farmer_chat_seed_7.en: Crops into drink, drink into money, money into seeds... A proper circle. Makes rather more sense than the route that brought me here.

farmer_chat_ranch_0.zh: 今天来得慢了些。小猪不肯走，牛又不肯快走。我夹在中间，倒像是它们赶着我做生意。
farmer_chat_ranch_0.en: A slow journey today. The pig would not walk; the calf would not hurry. Between the two, it felt as though they were taking me to market.

farmer_chat_ranch_1.zh: 牛奶这东西，瓶子一装就显得体面了。早些年我们直接拿碗接，味道也没少半分。
farmer_chat_ranch_1.en: Milk looks respectable in a bottle, does it not? We used to catch it straight in a bowl. Never seemed to hurt the taste.

farmer_chat_ranch_2.zh: 猪鼻子比我会找值钱的东西。我找半天只捡到个螺帽，它一拱，大家倒围过来了。
farmer_chat_ranch_2.en: The pig has a better nose for valuables than I do. I spent ages finding a nut off a bolt. One bit of digging from the pig, and suddenly everyone was interested.

farmer_chat_ranch_3.zh: 要是听见小家伙们叫，先看看吃食。我有一回跟它们讲了半天道理，最后还是一把饲料管用。
farmer_chat_ranch_3.en: If the little ones are making a fuss, check their food first. I once spent ages trying to reason with them. A handful of feed worked better.

farmer_chat_ranch_4.zh: 我把围裙洗了。结果刚出门，小猪就给我添了两个蹄印。挺好，省得人家以为我不干活。
farmer_chat_ranch_4.en: Washed my apron today. Had barely left the door before the pig added two little hoofprints. Saves people thinking I never do any work.

farmer_chat_ranch_5.zh: 这草帽旧是旧了点。可牛认得，小猪也认得；哪天换了新的，我怕它们还得重新认老板。
farmer_chat_ranch_5.en: An old hat, yes, but the cattle know it. So do the pigs. If I ever get a new one, they might need introducing to their keeper all over again.

farmer_chat_aqua_0.zh: 以前我嫌水缸不够大，如今倒盼着水缸少一点。鱼是不说话，张嘴吃饭的时候可一点不含糊。
farmer_chat_aqua_0.en: Used to wish for bigger tanks. Now I sometimes wish for fewer of them. Fish may keep quiet, but there is nothing shy about their appetite.

farmer_chat_aqua_1.zh: 海参看着不着急，我盯着它看了一会儿，也跟着不着急了。直到想起，租金可不会陪咱们慢慢来。
farmer_chat_aqua_1.en: A sea cucumber never seems in a hurry. Watched one for a while and felt quite peaceful myself. Then I remembered the rent does not share its patience.

farmer_chat_aqua_2.zh: 水里清不清，光闻可不成。我上回刚想夸一句，旁边那条鱼已经先把意见摆在脸上了。
farmer_chat_aqua_2.en: A sniff will not tell you whether the water is good. Was about to compliment a tank once, until I noticed the look on the fish.

farmer_chat_aqua_3.zh: 我问过海参，天天在缸底忙什么。它没搭理我。挺好，比有些欠账的客人还省心。
farmer_chat_aqua_3.en: Asked a sea cucumber what keeps it so busy down there. No answer. Still, less trouble than certain customers who owe me money.

farmer_chat_aqua_4.zh: 龙虾钳子上可没写着不许碰，是我后来补的。你要买它，那张纸也送你。
farmer_chat_aqua_4.en: The lobster did not come with a warning about its claws. I added that myself. Buy it, and I will throw in the warning for free.

farmer_chat_aqua_5.zh: 装龙虾那会儿，它夹着筐沿不松手。我跟它说到了能住水缸，它倒像是想先看看房。
farmer_chat_aqua_5.en: The lobster would not let go of the basket rim. Told it there was a tank waiting at the other end. Seemed to want a viewing first.

farm_config_auto_immunity.zh: 低免疫／普通疾病自动使用绿色血清
farm_config_auto_immunity.en: Automatic green serum for low immunity or ordinary illness

farm_config_auto_immunity_hint.zh: 默认关闭。夜间结算前，逐只对免疫低于物种阈值或患普通疾病的自有动物使用主背包／仓库里的绿色血清，消耗实际次数；不取其他机器内的药。药效仍在时不重复，不能清除朊病毒，且会增加食量。
farm_config_auto_immunity_hint.en: Off by default. Before nightly disease checks, spend real green-serum doses on each owned animal below its species' immunity threshold or with ordinary illness. Use main-inventory/warehouse supplies, reserving medicine inside machines. No repeat while active. Does not clear prion disease and increases hunger.

farm_night_status.zh: 动物情况：存活{0}只，卵{1}份；缺粮{2}只，待处理尸体{3}只。
farm_night_status.en: Animals: {0} alive, {1} egg clutches; {2} low on food, {3} carcasses to clear.

farm_night_growth_none.zh: 预计成长：暂无可估算的下一阶段。
farm_night_growth_none.en: Expected growth: no next stage can currently be estimated.

farm_night_blocked.zh: 另有{0}批因空间不足暂停转阶段。
farm_night_blocked.en: {0} group(s) waiting for room to change stage.

farm_night_safe.zh: 疫病预警：未发现普通疾病、朊病毒或环境风险。
farm_night_safe.en: Disease warning: no ordinary illness, prion disease or environmental risks detected.

farm_night_ill.zh: 普通疾病{0}只，可手动用绿色血清
farm_night_ill.en: {0} with ordinary illness; green serum can help immunity

farm_night_prion.zh: 朊病毒{0}只，血清无法清除
farm_night_prion.en: {0} with prion disease; serum cannot clear it

farm_night_water.en: {0} tank(s) short of water or with poor water quality

farm_night_treated.zh: 昨晚自动使用绿色血清{0}次。
farm_night_treated.en: Green serum automatically used {0} time(s) last night.

farm_config_auto_feces.zh: 自动将粪便转入垃圾桶

farm_config_auto_feces_hint.zh: 默认开启。没有清洁机器人的笼子直接清理粪便；有机器人时仅在收集仓接近满载时清仓。垃圾桶满则保留原物。关闭可保留粪便制水；原版机器人的收集与焚烧由其自身设置决定。
farm_config_auto_feces_hint.en: On by default. Clear feces from cages without a cleaner robot; with a robot, empty only near-full collection storage. A full trash bin leaves items in place. Turn off to retain feces for water production. Native robot collection/incineration follows its own controls.

farm_config_robot_trash.zh: 清洁机器人转垃圾桶阈值（占格%）

farm_config_robot_trash_hint.zh: 默认80%。只处理当前笼内的清洁机器人，每台机器人每晚至多成功清仓一次。
farm_config_robot_trash_hint.en: Default 80%. Only robots serving the same cage are checked; each robot is successfully emptied at most once per night.

farm_config_feed_report.zh: 夜报显示各机器饲料余量
farm_config_feed_report.en: Show per-machine feed supplies in night logs

farm_config_feed_report_hint.zh: 按机器列出分配器内已处理且符合食性的饲料。编号随存档保留，自定义名称优先；按预计余量从少到多排列。估算包含当前群体成长和正常产物消耗，不计仓库、未来补料或新增幼崽。
farm_config_feed_report_hint.en: List processed, diet-compatible dispenser feed per machine. Saved numbers stay stable; custom names take priority. Lowest estimated supplies appear first. Estimates include existing stock growth and normal production, excluding warehouse food, future deliveries and new births.

farm_config_feed_only_low.zh: 饲料清单仅显示需要补料的机器

farm_config_feed_only_low_hint.zh: 默认关闭，列出所有正在饲养的笼／缸。开启后只列低于提醒天数、缺分配器、饲料不适口或目标饱食度过低的机器，适合后期机器较多时使用。
farm_config_feed_only_low_hint.en: Off by default: list every active cage/tank. When on, list low supplies, missing dispensers, incompatible feed or low fullness targets only, useful with many machines.

farm_waste_blocked.zh: 垃圾桶不可用、空间不足或物品受限，未能转移的粪便已保留。
farm_waste_blocked.en: Trash unavailable, full or transfer restricted; unmoved feces retained.

farm_feed_target.zh: 目标饱食度低于75%，请检查设置

farm_feed_wrong_diet.zh: 没有适口饲料，请检查食性

farm_feed_eggs.zh: 仅有卵，暂不耗料，请预备幼体饲料
farm_feed_eggs.en: eggs only; no current feed demand, prepare larval feed

hydro_stop_hint.zh: 本轮收获后停机；关闭可续作。
hydro_stop_hint.en: Finish one harvest, then pause. Turn off to resume.

hydro_clear_hint.zh: 换种：短柄斧点植株或机器，不返种。
hydro_clear_hint.en: Hatchet the plant or machine to change crops; no seed refund.

hydro_stopped.zh: 已停机；关闭“收获后停机”可续作
hydro_stopped.en: Paused; turn off Stop after harvest to resume
